categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Scripts and tools' label and modifies a developer helper tool under contrib/devtools.
categories.rationale: Dramatically speeds up deterministic fuzz coverage analysis by skipping redundant report rendering when raw profile data matches byte-for-byte. Reviewer benchmarks showed runtime dropping from 1h50m to ~26m on `process_message` and from 5m49s to 31s on `addition_overflow`, though the tool serves a specialized fuzzing workflow rather than daily contributor or operator tasks.
